questions.question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

We bought / two dozens / mangoes from / the market.
questions.solution:
The erroneous art is **'two dozens'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is grammatically incorrect.
 
• Here,** 'two dozen' **should be used instead of** 'two dozens'.**
 
• We never write **‘dozens’ **if we are using a numerical amount like *two, three, etc. *before it.
 
 
• *For example, **‘two dozens of bananas’ **is incorrect but **‘three dozen of mangoes’ **is correct. *
 
 
 
• Similarly, the given sentence has ‘**two**’ as** a numerical value.**
 
• Thus, the correct answer is** Option 4.**

 

**Correct Sentence:__** *We bought **two dozen** mangoes from the market.*

questions.question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.**

She exclaimed with sorrow that life had become miserable.

options.text: She said, “How miserable had become life!”
She said, “Oh! What miserable life will become.”
She said, “Alas! How miserable life has become.”

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **She said, "Alas! How miserable life has become".**

***__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in Indirect Speech. As per the question we have to change it into Direct Speech. 
 
• The process of transformation is as follows: 
 
 
• The given sentence is an example of an Exclamatory Sentence.
 
• The notion of these kinds of sentences is 'joy, sorrow, surprise, applause, detest, hate, etc.' 
 
• Reporting Verbs are changed according to the notion of Reported Speech. These verbs are: 'exclaimed with surprise, exclaimed with sorrow, exclaimed with joy, exclaimed with contempt, etc.'
 
• Exclamatory words 'Ah!, Ha!, My God!, Oh!, Alas!, Bravo!' are removed in Indirect Speech. 
 
• 'That' is used in place of 'Inverted commas'. 
 
• 'Tense, Pronoun, and Adverbials' are changed according to assertive sentences. 
 
• *Example:*
 
 
• *Nitin said, "What a match it was!". (Direct Speech)*
 
• *Nitin exclaimed that it was a good match. (Indirect Speech)*
 
 
 
• 'exclaimed with sorrow' will be changed into '**said**'.
 
• Comma and inverted commas will be added.
 
• 'had' will be changed into '**has**'. 

 ​
 
 

Correct Sentence:__ She said, "Alas! How miserable life has become".*

questions.question:
**Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.**

A. Thus, shared laughter is one of the most effective tools in maintaining healthy relationships.

B. Emotional sharing builds strong and lasting bonds.

C. It also helps in healing resentments and hurt.

D. But sharing laughter brings joy and freshness to relationships.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**BDCA**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given question is an example of a Para Jumble.
 
• We know that the first statement of a para jumbled question is usually an independent general statement, a noun, a universal fact, starting of an incident, or it starts with 'most' or 'once'. 
 
• **Sentence B** will be the starting line as it contains the main idea of the parajumble i.e. Emotional sharing.
 
• However, **Sentence D** states that sharing laughter brings joy and freshness to relationships. So, **D** will follow **B**.
 
• Further, **Sentence C** states that it also helps in healing resentments and hurt and **sentence** **A** states that shared laughter is one of the most effective tools in maintaining healthy relationships. So, **A** will follow **C**.
 
• Thus, the correct sequence is:
 
 
• **B**: Emotional sharing builds strong and lasting bonds.
 
• **D**: But sharing laughter brings joy and freshness to relationships.
 
• **C**: It also helps in healing resentments and hurt.
 
• **A**: Thus, shared laughter is one of the most effective tools in maintaining healthy relationships.

 
 
 

**Correct Sequence:__** *Emotional sharing builds strong and lasting bonds. But sharing laughter brings joy and freshness to relationships. It also helps in healing resentments and hurt. Thus, shared laughter is one of the most effective tools in maintaining healthy relationships.*
